correctness.rationale: Exact graph definitions and exhaustive include/exclude enumeration yield 253880 augmented simplices. Two deterministic global element matchings are certified gradient-acyclic over all 1574120 directed Hasse cover relations. Removing the empty-face pair leaves a critical vertex; positive Morse boundary ranks and Smith factors are computed exactly from signed gradient paths. Seed 138 has critical (1,149,12) in degrees 5,6,7 with Smith factors (1) and (1 repeated seven); seed 1 gives (9,172,27) and Smith factors all one of respective ranks 9 and 22. Both give H6=Z^141, H7=Z^5 and no other positive homology or torsion. Since there are no cells in degrees 1–4 and the primitive attaching matrices classify maps into wedges of 5- and 6-spheres, unit cell cancellations prove an integral wedge homotopy type.

value.rationale: P4 Cartesian C5 is the first genuinely pentagonal odd-circumference four-row square cylinder and the next natural width boundary beyond the previously classified P3 Cartesian C5 and P4 Cartesian C4. The periodic seam changes the comparison P4 Cartesian P5 from 41 degree-six spheres to a mixed homotopy with 141 degree-six and five degree-seven spheres; these five new higher classes and exact integral attaching data are mathematically meaningful boundary-sensitive information, not just an arbitrary graph statistic. The finite result is fully reproducible and useful for testing transfer or recurrence approaches to cylindrical matching complexes.
